limiterDetail: The main limiter is still east wind on the south and east grounds: Nangalao 21 kt (gusts 27), Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 20 kt (gusts 26), Ciron 18 kt (gusts 24), Barangonan 17 kt (gusts 21), Linapacan 15 kt (gusts 20). changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the last digest (Thu 12, 6:20 AM)
items: Fishing improved a lot this afternoon: six grounds are GOOD now. Fishing right now is 6 GOOD / 1 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 2 VERY POOR (was 2 GOOD / 3 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 6 VERY POOR). Galoc, Turda, Maglalambay and Panlaitan moved up to GOOD (wind 6–10 kt, current 0.0–0.4 kt) alongside Tara and Decabobo. Cabunlawan, Alava, Ciron and Barangonan recovered from VERY POOR to POOR. Only Nangalao (21 kt, gusts 27) and Decabaitot (20 kt, gusts 26, current 1.5 kt) stay VERY POOR.

Regional wind: Thu 12 12 kt, gusts 20 (was 14), Fri 13 12 kt, gusts 17 (was 13), Sat 14 9.8 kt (was 12), Sun 15 9.2 kt (was 7.5), Mon 16 12 kt, gusts 19, Tue 17 11 kt (was 9.4), Wed 18 3.8 kt. Supply outlook is slightly better for Fri 13–Sat 14, but Mon 16 now looks better (not soft) and Tue 17 is softer than before. Shortage detector ELEVATED Thu–Tue; surge OFF. PAGASA feed was unreachable again (SSL error); the CLEAR on the dashboard is only a default, not a confirmed check.

details: Today (12 kt, gusts 20) is the rough regional day , with arrivals soft Thu and slightly soft Fri–Sat. Relief arrives Sun 15 (9.2 kt) with Sat 14 a partial easing (9.8 kt); Mon 16 and Tue 17 rebuild to 11–12 kt, then Wed 18 is the best day (3.8 kt).
